description: TST-R017 expectation file for the static-render budget gate. This binds the P4 perf-static scene (800 disjoint opaque sprites, 4 atlases, no scripting) to its counter bounds so a regression in batching, tessellation or allocations fails the gate, not just the CI wall-clock. Wall-clock numbers are reported by the harness on real devices (TST-R016); the values here are deterministic counters measured on the headless stub GL.

tessellationMsCold1000.note: GFX §16 T-GFX-051: one-off cold tessellation of a 1000-shape scene.

drawCalls.note: TST §7.2: 2 draws per batch (stencil + cover), ≤ 210 opaque-by-material batches.

batches.note: Segment planner must group disjoint same-material opaque runs.

bufferUploadBytes.note: Static: first frame uploads once; steady state must be 0.

steadyStateAllocationsPer600Frames.note: T-GFX-021: zero per-frame allocations after warm-up.

contextLossRecovered.note: T-GFX-060: after webglcontextlost → restored, the renderer rebuilds programs and repaints.

drawCalls.note: Static opaque runs are batchable regardless of device.

tessellationMsCold1000.note: Looser CI cap to absorb runner jitter; the real budget is asserted on baseline-desktop per TST-R016.

determinism.note: T-GFX-020: the same frame must issue the identical GL command sequence twice.
